reasons.plausibility: Al is known to form brittle intermetallics with refractory elements (e.g., HfAl, TiAl) and strongly stabilizes B2 or Laves phases, making a single-phase BCC solid solution highly unlikely; the hypothesis ignores this well-established phase stability problem.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and includes quantitative rejection criteria (density reduction <10%, strength drop >10%, secondary phases), which would decisively falsify the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses a critical trade-off but is based on a physically unsound premise, so it would mislead rather than guide a researcher; a more useful hypothesis would consider elements that do not form brittle phases.
